description: Repairs r-lock-3-4-txn/txn-local-xproc-same-page and -same-row: b's competing write was always refused (3260) and never retried after A's release, so the resolution orders and whether an unrelated update survives A's rollback were not exercised. Phase 1: process a begins a transaction and updates N of row 1; process b (no transaction) tries UPDATE T SET V = V + 5 WHERE ID = 2 (DBEngine.Errors right before and after); a rolls back; b repeats the same statement and reads rows 1, 2 and 64 and row 1 of U; a reads them. Phase 2: a begins and updates N of row 1 again; b tries the statement; a commits; b repeats it, waits 7 s, calls DBEngine.Idle(dbRefreshCache) and reads; a reads. Then the same two phases with b's statement on row 1 (the same row).
